subject: science
name: Science
title: Grade 2 Science: Matter, Landforms, Plant Needs & Habitats
overview: Grade 2 Science engages students in the scientific method and engineering design process across physical, life, and Earth/space sciences aligned with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).
competencies: Ask scientific questions, plan and conduct controlled investigations, and analyze experimental data.
Develop and use models to describe natural systems, energy flows, and physical interactions.
Construct explanations supported by empirical evidence and scientific reasoning.
Design, test, and optimize engineering solutions to real-world technological and environmental problems.

modules.title: Structure and Properties of Matter
modules.description: Classifying different kinds of materials by their observable properties, testing reversible vs. irreversible changes.

topics.title: Classifying Solids, Liquids and Gases
topics.description: Testing flexibility, hardness, texture, and absorbency of common matter.

topics.title: Heating, Cooling and Reversible Changes
topics.description: Observing how melting and freezing can be reversed, while cooking changes matter permanently.

modules.title: Earth Systems: Landforms, Water & Fast/Slow Changes
modules.description: Mapping where water is found on Earth, exploring volcanoes and earthquakes, and preventing soil erosion.

topics.title: Slow and Rapid Changes to Earth's Surface
topics.description: Contrasting slow weathering and erosion with sudden volcanic eruptions and earthquakes.

topics.title: Mapping Earth's Water and Landforms
topics.description: Locating oceans, lakes, rivers, glaciers, mountains, and valleys on physical maps.

topics.title: Engineering Solutions for Wind and Water Erosion
topics.description: Designing and testing dikes, seawalls, and plant cover to prevent wind and rain erosion.

modules.title: Interdependent Relationships in Ecosystems
modules.description: Investigating what plants need to grow and the vital roles animals play in seed dispersal and pollination.

topics.title: Plant Survival: Sunlight and Water Experiments
topics.description: Conducting controlled trials with seeds in varying light and moisture conditions.

topics.title: Pollination, Seed Dispersal & Biodiversity
topics.description: Modeling how bees, butterflies, and wind spread pollen and how animals bury seeds.
